description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing LXC containers, including network interface iteration, container configuration, and container administration within the Thunder ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network interfaces within an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container with management and configuration capabilities.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Container configuration class with nested ConfigItem class.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair for container configuration.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages creation and lifecycle of LXC containers.

methods.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network interface.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Type
methods.description: Returns the container type, which is LXC.

methods.name: LXCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: LXCContainerAdministrator::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with configuration.
